description.value: The complete developer platform to build, scale, and deliver secure software.

A proprietary developer platform for creating, storing, managing and sharing code. It uses Git for distributed version control and adds access control, bug tracking, task management, continuous integration and wikis.
A cloud platform for hosting and managing software code, built around Git, the distributed version control system.

product_description.value: Products listed on the site include GitHub Copilot (AI coding), Actions (workflow automation), Codespaces, Issues, Code Review, GitHub Advanced Security and Secret protection.
GitHub Enterprise, a self-managed version of the platform; GitHub Pages hosting; and GitHub Copilot, an AI coding tool.
Pull requests, issue tracking, GitHub Actions for CI/CD, and GitHub Copilot, an AI pair programmer powered by OpenAI Codex.

business_model_description.value: Freemium: public repositories have always been free, and since April 2020 core features, including private repositories with unlimited collaborators, are free for everyone. It also sells subscription-style services such as GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Copilot.
Paid add-ons named on the company site include Copilot for Business and Premium Support. The page lists no prices.
Primarily a freemium model, with paid plans for private repositories and organizations, plus enterprise agreements and a Marketplace take.
Freemium pricing with paid plans for organizations and per-user tiers. Actions and Packages charge for usage beyond plan allotments.

customer_description.value: The company says 90% of the Fortune 100 use GitHub, with 225M+ developers and 4M+ organizations.
Named customer: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, a $200,000 contract for GitHub Enterprise Server.
One source reports over 100 million developers and more than 372 million repositories as of January 2023; another gives 180 million developers and 4 million organizations.

revenue.value: $1 billion annual recurring revenue (October 2022, Satya Nadella on an earnings call); about $2 billion run rate (2024, Latka estimate)

employees.value: 3,787 (Wikipedia infobox); an older snapshot of the same page showed 5,595

headquarters.value: San Francisco, CA (88 Colin P Kelly Jr St, corporate office per PitchBook)
